description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering search parameters related to employee reviewer and supervisor in the Performance module of OrangeHRM. It encapsulates filtering criteria such as employee number and name or ID, and manages the sorting field for search results.

classes.name: ReviewEmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filter parameters for employee supervisor review in the performance context. It includes filtering attributes and preset sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field set to 'employee.empNumber'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getNameOrId
methods.description: Returns the name or ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setNameOrId
methods.description: Sets the name or ID filter criterion.
